content.short: Cardano Assets is an explorer for Cardano tokens and NFTs with price aggregation and registry-linked asset data.
content.description: Cardano Assets is an explorer focused on Cardano-native assets and NFTs. The platform presents tokens with asset-level information, price aggregation, and data tied to the Cardano Foundation registry so users can inspect projects and collections from a single interface. Its role in the ecosystem is practical: make Cardano assets easier to search, compare, and understand without digging through raw on-chain records.
